fullPassage: Marine plastic pollution is a complex problem that occurs on many levels, as it presents physical, chemical, and biological implications for marine compartments at small scales while involving vast geographic domains. To counteract what can be regarded as a planetary boundary threat, we need tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge in an accessible manner. To this end, laboratory experiments and observations are indeed fundamental to capture specific aspects of plastic and plastic-related pollution; yet this zoo of data is still insufficient to provide a holistic description of this pervasive phenomenon. Quantitative methods can link and exploit our current understanding of the different processes and complex interaction characterizing marine plastic pollution to ultimately help to shed some light on aspects that are hard to investigate in the field. Actions against marine pollution have to be timely, bold, and knowledge-based. In this perspective, comprehensive, data-informed approaches can help not only to identify and protect the mechanisms that interconnect marine ecosystems but also to understand the processes and synergies that are disrupting them.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ regarding → regarded (수동태 과거분사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② capturing → capture (to부정사 원형 필요)
det.analysis:
✅ ① occurs(S1): 'problem that occurs'에서 관계대명사절 3인칭 단수 동사 적절

✅ ③ exploit(S4): 'can link and exploit'에서 조동사 뒤 원형 적절

✅ ④ characterizing(S4): 'interaction characterizing marine pollution'에서 현재분사 후치수식 적절
det.tip: fundamental to + 동사원형(to부정사): ~하기 위해 근본적인. to는 to부정사의 to이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ disrupted → disrupting (능동 진행형 필요)
det.analysis:
✅ ① what(S2): 'counteract what can be regarded as'에서 선행사 포함 관계대명사 적절

✅ ③ hard(S4): 'aspects that are hard to investigate'에서 보어 형용사 적절

❌ ④ disrupted → disrupting: 'processes that are disrupted them'에서 'them'이라는 목적어가 있으므로 능동 진행형 disrupting이 필요. 수동태 disrupted이면 목적어를 취할 수 없음 ←정답
det.tip: 능동 vs 수동: are disrupting them(능동, 목적어 있음) vs are disrupted(수동, 목적어 없음).

det.korean: ② generic(일반적인) → tailored(맞춤형)

det.tip: tailored(맞춤형) ≠ generic(일반적). 해양 오염 문제의 복잡성에 맞는 도구가 필요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 해양 플라스틱 오염이 지구적 위협으로 간주된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① Schools teach students about plastic recycling daily.(학교가 매일 재활용을 가르침)
→ 원문에 학교 교육 언급 전혀 없음

✅ ② Marine plastic pollution is regarded as a global threat.(해양 오염이 지구적 위협으로 간주됨)
→ 본문: 'a planetary boundary threat' 일치 ←정답

❌ ③ Governments have eliminated all ocean plastic waste.(정부가 모든 해양 폐기물 제거)
→ 원문에 정부의 폐기물 제거 언급 없음

❌ ④ Deep-sea creatures are immune to plastic pollution.(심해 생물이 오염에 면역)
→ 원문에 심해 생물 면역 언급 없음
det.tip: 원문: 'what can be regarded as a planetary boundary threat' = 지구적 위협.

det.analysis:
❌ ① 체계적으로 분류된 결과
→ zoo는 '혼란스러운 다양함'을 의미하며 체계적 분류와 반대

❌ ② 동물 보호 데이터
→ zoo의 문자적 의미가 아닌 비유적 의미

❌ ③ 단일 유형 자료
→ zoo는 '다양한' 것들의 혼합을 의미

✅ ④ 다양하지만 통합되지 않은 혼란스러운 데이터 집합
→ zoo 비유는 다양한 종류의 데이터가 동물원의 동물들처럼 각자 다르고 통합되지 않은 상태를 나타냄. 'insufficient to provide a holistic description'과 연결 ←정답
det.tip: zoo of data: '데이터의 동물원'은 다양하지만 통합되지 않은 데이터의 혼란스러운 상태를 비유한다.

ch: 소규모 실험에서 얻은 단일 유형의 자료

questions.passage: Marine plastic pollution is a complex problem that occurs on many levels, as it presents physical, chemical, and biological implications for marine compartments at small scales while involving vast geographic domains. To counteract what can be regarded as a planetary boundary threat, we need tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge in an accessible manner. To this end, laboratory experiments and observations are indeed fundamental to capture specific aspects of plastic and plastic-related pollution; yet this zoo of data is still insufficient to provide a holistic description of this pervasive phenomenon. Quantitative methods can link and exploit our current understanding of the different processes and complex interaction characterizing marine plastic pollution to ultimately help to shed some light on aspects that are hard to investigate in the field. Actions against marine pollution have to be timely, bold, and knowledge-based. In this perspective, comprehensive, data-informed approaches can help not only to identify and protect the mechanisms that interconnect marine ecosystems but also to understand the processes and synergies that are disrupting <u>them</u>.

det.korean: 다양한 지식 층위를 제공하기 위한 맞춤형 도구

구문: tailored instruments(맞춤형 도구) + to provide(제공하기 위한) + various layers of knowledge(다양한 지식 층위).

8단어: tailored(1) instruments(2) to(3) provide(4) various(5) layers(6) of(7) knowledge(8).
det.tip: tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge: 맞춤형 도구가 다양한 지식을 제공해야 한다.
